Current booking-conflicts-v3/stockholm-capacity-v1 facts including every booking jobId and complete ordered per-job independently null/empty roles/windows; independent SQL canonical bytes/digest; genuine series proof/review with series metadata baseline, actual new ordered claim protocol and genuine single/editor/card receipt verifier donors; actual signed invalid binding attacks; preserve all 13 old claim names/order and existing protocol domains

Metadata-only change probes preserve detector input values, including already-cancelled tombstone status, while changing recurrence linkage/series state; raw detector digest stays unchanged and series metadata digest changes.
